OPPO K14 Lite India Launch on September 16: 7000mAh Battery, Specs Revealed

OPPO K14 Lite launches in India on September 16 with a 7000mAh  battery, 120Hz display, IP64 rating and ColorOS 16. Check confirmed details.1 min

by Paras Guglani 2 days ago2 days ago
21views
Compare Android Phones
0

Instaread

OPPO is preparing to launch a new budget  smartphone in India. The OPPO K14 Lite will officially launch on September 16, 2026, at 12 PM IST, with Flipkart confirmed as its online sales partner.

Discover more
Battery
mobile
Explore iOS Apps

The  phone is being positioned around battery life and everyday durability. Its biggest highlight is a large 7,000mAh battery, while OPPO is also promising battery performance that can remain reliable for up to six years.

Large battery and 120Hz display

The OPPO K14 Lite will feature a 6.75-inch HD+ LCD display with a 120Hz refresh rate. This should make scrolling, social media and everyday navigation feel smoother than standard 60Hz screens.

Batteries

The 7,000mAh battery is the main attraction. OPPO says the phone can offer up to 675.13 hours of standby time and up to 26.84 hours of video playback. The company has also highlighted six-year battery durability.

Camera, software and durability

The phone will have a 13MP rear camera with software features including AI Eraser, Face Retouch, Night Mode and Portrait Mode. It will come with 4GB of RAM, with virtual RAM expansion allowing up to 8GB of total memory.

The K14 Lite will run ColorOS 16 based on Android 16. It will also carry an IP64 rating for protection against dust and everyday water splashes. OPPO has added Splash Touch support, allowing the display to respond better when the user’s fingers are wet or oily.

Discover more
Choose Tech Accessories
Choose Power Supplies
Phone

The phone will be offered in Feather Purple and Stone Brown colour options. The available storage configurations and official Indian price are expected to be announced at launch.

OPPO K14 Lite India launch date

The OPPO K14 Lite will launch in India on September 16 at 12 PM IST and will be sold through Flipkart. With its 7,000mAh battery, 120Hz display and long-term battery durability promise, the phone could attract buyers who put battery life ahead of high-end performance.

OPPO is expected to reveal the remaining specifications and official pricing during the launch event.

Measure advertising performance

Information regarding which advertising is presented to you and how you interact with it can be used to determine how well an advert has worked for you or other users and whether the goals of the advertising were reached. Measure content performance

Information regarding which content is presented to you and how you interact with it can be used to determine whether the (non-advertising) content e.g. reached its intended audience and matched your interests. For instance, whether you read an article, watch a video, listen to a podcast or look at a product description, how long you spent on this service and the web pages you visit etc. This is very helpful to understand the relevance of (non-advertising) content that is shown to you.

Understand audiences through statistics or combinations of data from different sources

Reports can be generated based on the combination of data sets (like user profiles, statistics, market research, analytics data) regarding your interactions and those of other users with advertising or (non-advertising) content to identify common characteristics (for instance, to determine which target audiences are more receptive to an ad campaign or to certain contents).

Use limited data to select content

Ensure security, prevent and detect fraud, and fix errors

Your data can be used to monitor for and prevent unusual and possibly fraudulent activity (for example, regarding advertising, ad clicks by bots), and ensure systems and processes work properly and securely. Save and communicate privacy choices

Link different devices

CMP privacy choices

Storage, duration, and usage details

The choices you make with this CMP regarding the purposes and entities will affect how personalized advertising is presented to you. We need to store these choices to respect them on future visits, and they are stored differently based on the type of site or app you're using:
  • For sites, your choices are saved in a cookie named “FCCDCF” for a maximum duration of 390 days.
  • For apps, your choices are saved in device storage prefixed by “IABTCF_”. Your choices will be invalidated after 390 days and overwritten once you make new privacy choices on this app.
  • For accelerated mobile page (AMP) sites, your choices are saved in local storage prefixed by “amp-store”. Your choices will be invalidated after 390 days and overwritten once you make new privacy choices on this site.
